prompt: A system administrator discovers that the system is not referencing individual PAM configuration files in the /etc/pam.d/ directory, even though they exist. Before escalating the issue, the administrator should first check which file that might override these individual configurations?
explanation: The /etc/pam.conf file provides PAM configuration for all services and, when present, can override or take precedence over the individual per-service files in /etc/pam.d/.
